data.title: Announced job cuts, technology sector (Challenger, Gray & Christmas)
data.summary: A count of announcements of planned job cuts by US-based employers rather than of completed separations; not an official statistic. It reports 133,988 technology-sector cuts announced in 2024, 154,445 in 2025 and 149,023 between January and July 2026 — 67% above the 89,251 announced in the same months of 2025.
data.citation: Challenger, Gray & Christmas, Job Cut Announcement Report, July 2026.
